FIFA COO Kevin Lamour Departs Amid Criticism of President Infantino

FIFA's chief operating officer, Kevin Lamour, has departed his role weeks after accusing president Gianni Infantino of deceiving staff regarding a plan to sell parts of the World Cup to investors. Sky News reported that FIFA sacked Lamour after he criticized Infantino's plan. Other outlets confirmed Lamour's exit, noting his criticism of Infantino's alleged deception.
